subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should this issue stay open until a current-main vLLM `gpt-oss-120b` large-system-prompt repro proves the parser still drops tool calls, or is the reduced structured-stream coverage enough to treat it as fixed?
rationale: The current source handles the reduced reasoning-before-structured-tool-call shape, but the issue's observed raw-JSON-as-text failure is not explained by current or reported-version static source, and heuristic recovery would change the tool execution boundary.

options.title: Keep open for exact proof
options.body: Require a current-main vLLM repro or focused fixture that turns the reported stream into text before accepting a code fix or close.

options.title: Close as covered by source
options.body: Accept the reduced structured-stream parser coverage as sufficient and close without live vLLM proof.

options.title: Sponsor guarded recovery
options.body: Approve a narrow provider-gated text-to-tool recovery design with explicit security tests before implementation.
